title: Overwatch Patch Notes – May 8, 2018
raw_text: May 8, 2018 Overwatch Patch Notes – May 8, 2018 A new patch is now live on PC. Read below to learn more about the latest changes. To share your feedback, please post in the General Discussion forum For a list of known issues, visit our Bug Report forum. For troubleshooting assistance, visit our Technical Support forum. BUG FIXES General Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the client to freeze Top of post
